notes.title: Re.dive Wonderland DEMO Update - 250717
notes.notes: [p]🎮 Thank you so much to everyone who played our demo![/p][p]We’ve released an update on Steam, so please make sure to play with the latest build.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s what’s included in this update:[/p][p]- Story edits and translation review[/p][p]- New character outfits and cutscene images, with some illustration tweaks[/p][p]- \[Menu] button added to the bottom-right of the dialogue box[/p][p]- Loading screens added between scene transitions[/p][p]- Skill cut-ins and chapter videos updated[/p][p]- Various bug fixes[/p][p][/p][p]⚠️ Please note: save files from previous versions are not compatible with this update.[/p][p]We kindly ask that you delete your old save data before playing the new version.[/p][p][/p][p]Regarding the English translation:[/p][p]We initially outsourced the translation to an external agency, but we’ve received feedback that there are some quality issues.[/p][p]Although we’ve done a first pass at reviewing the script internally, as a small indie team, we currently don’t have a dedicated professional translator.[/p][p]We promise to have the full translation properly reviewed by experts before the official release.[/p][p]In the meantime, we’d be truly grateful for your understanding and patience.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for all your feedback and support—we’re always listening and doing our best to improve. Please continue to look forward to what's coming next![/p]

notes.title: Re.dive Wonderland - Demo release
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587770/68300364d1f86c850ba8568e34f7dcba64a2a394.gif"][/img]Hello, this is Piacere.[/p][p]The official demo version of [i]Re.dive Wonderland[/i] will finally be released today at 6 PM (KST)![/p][p]This demo features the early part of the main story, offering over an hour of gameplay. You'll get a first look at the worldbuilding, meet key characters, and experience the emotional tone and narrative style that define the series.[/p][p]English is supported as well, so we truly hope many of you will enjoy it![/p]
